question: How does the CO2 loading of the amino-functionalized ionic liquid phase change absorbent compare with that of the conventional AMP/MEA/H2O system, as a ratio?
expect: about 3.6 times: 1.79 vs 0.5 mol/mol, both at 303.15 K (Table 2)
rendered:
The CO2 loading of the amino-functionalized ionic liquid phase change absorbent, [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O, is 1.79 mol CO2 mol−1 IL, while the conventional AMP/MEA/H2O system achieves only 0.5 mol CO2 mol−1. 

Therefore, the ratio of the CO2 loading of the amino-functionalized ionic liquid phase change absorbent to that of the conventional AMP/MEA/H2O system is 1.79 / 0.5 = 3.58.
